comment: The distinction between SGI and runtime services is valuable. However, the document presents cross-registry semantic governance as a new aspect introduced by DPI-H without sufficiently qualifying similar work in standards organisations, national terminology centres, metadata repositories, and enterprise data-governance programmes.

anchor.note: p.58 l.Lines 400-416 read as the printed page; section 3.4.5 agrees

public.text: The distinction between SGI and runtime services is valuable. However, the document presents cross-registry semantic governance as a new aspect introduced by DPI-H without sufficiently qualifying similar work in standards organisations, national terminology centres, metadata repositories, and enterprise data-governance programmes.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify that the contribution is the integration and explicit architectural treatment of these capabilities across DPI-H components, rather than claiming that cross-asset semantic governance itself is entirely new.
